name: NGC 4851 (Webb)
blurb: NGC 4851, a galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ngc4851-webb
story: Webb studied this Coma Cluster galaxy to read the faint graininess of its starlight, called surface brightness fluctuations, as one rung in a precise new distance ladder for cosmology.

claims.text: NGC 4851 is a target galaxy of the JWST SBF Coma Cluster Survey
NGC 4851 lies in Abell 1656 (the Coma Cluster)
The program measures surface brightness fluctuations to build a precision distance ladder for cosmology
